notes: Order 1; float32 synthetic inputs, scikit-fmm float64 reference. Wall times include harness serialization and Metal process startup, but exclude input construction and benchmark-worker startup. Memory is the maximum of three repeats in MiB; methods are not directly comparable. tracemalloc can miss native allocations; MLX peak excludes CPU marching allocations and RSS is a lifetime high-water mark. Metal RSS excludes GPU allocation accounting and is measured in a fresh worker for each repeat. Relative error is max absolute difference divided by maximum absolute reference time.
